overview: Alvin and the Chipmunks is a 2007 American musical comedy film based on the characters created by Ross Bagdasarian Sr. It was directed by Tim Hill from a screenplay by Jon Vitti, Will McRobb, and Chris Viscardi. The film stars Jason Lee, David Cross, and Cameron Richardson, with Justin Long, Matthew Gray Gubler, and Jesse McCartney in voice roles. It follows the chipmunks, who move in with struggling songwriter Dave Seville after losing their home.
